episodes.title: I A HARD MAN TO FIND
episodes.summary: Tom Ripley's life of petty crime in New York City detours with an offer to bring a wealthy man's wayward son home from Europe.

episodes.title: II SEVEN MERCIES
episodes.summary: On Italy's Amalfi Coast, Tom settles into Dickie's grand villa, but not without arousing suspicion from his girlfriend Marge.

episodes.title: III SOMMERSO
episodes.summary: With funds low and his future in Italy in jeopardy, Tom puts a dark scheme into motion.

episodes.title: IV LA DOLCE VITA
episodes.summary: Tom must deal with Marge's deep skepticism before embarking on a new, fictitious life in Rome.

episodes.title: V LUCIO
episodes.summary: Ensconced in a lovely Rome apartment, Tom's perfect life is threatened by the arrival of an unexpected visitor.

episodes.title: VI SOME HEAVY INSTRUMENT
episodes.summary: A ghastly discovery leads Rome police to Tom's doorstep, beginning a game of cat and mouse with its lead investigator.

episodes.title: VII MACABRE ENTERTAINMENT
episodes.summary: As Inspector Ravini expands his murder investigation, an elusive Tom plots his next moves from Sicily.

episodes.title: VIII NARCISSUS
episodes.summary: Tom reinvents himself again, creating an enviable life in Venice — as long as his lies hold.
